# Cloudcart

CloudCart is an e-commerce platform that enables businesses to create and manage online stores efficiently.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/cloudcart/.

## Actions

- **Add to Cart**: Add an item to the cart.
- **Clear Cart**: Remove all items from the specified cart.
- **Create Category**: Create a new category.
- **Create Customer**: Create a new customer in cloudcart.
- **Create Order**: Create a new order.
- **Create Product**: Create a new product.
- **Delete Category**: Delete a category by its id.
- **Delete Customer**: Delete a customer.
- **Delete Order**: Delete an order.
- **Delete Product**: Delete a product by its id.
- **Get Cart** (read-only): Retrieve the current shopping cart.
- **Get Categories** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all categories.
- **Get Customers** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all customers.
- **Get Orders** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all orders.
- **Get Payment Methods** (read-only): Retrieve all available payment methods.
- **Get Product With Relations** (read-only): Retrieve a product with related entities.
- **Get Products** (read-only): Retrieve a list of products with optional filters.
- **Get Shipping Methods** (read-only): Retrieve all available shipping methods.
- **List Order Payment** (read-only): Retrieve a list of order payments.
- **Remove from Cart**: Remove an item from the cart.
- **Update Cart Item**: Update the quantity of an item in the cart.
- **Update Category**: Update an existing category.
- **Update Customer**: Update an existing customer.
- **Update Order**: Update an existing order.
- **Update Product**: Update an existing product's details.
- **Create Variant**: Create a new product variant for a given product.
- **Create Variant Option**: Create a new variant option for a specific product variant.
- **Create Variant Parameter**: Create a new variant parameter for a product variant.
- **Create Vendor**: Create a new vendor via cloudcart api.
- **Delete Vendor**: Delete a vendor by its id.
- **Get Property Options Relationship** (read-only): Retrieve property options relationship for a product.
- **Get Vendor** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific vendor.
- **List Vendors** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all vendors.
- **Update Vendor**: Update an existing vendor.
